_note: v2, 2026-09-17. One line per Banking77 intent, revised after reading three random TRAIN examples per intent (never test). Several intent names are misleading in this dataset (get_physical_card is about the PIN; topping_up_by_card is about the customer's own card top-ups). Still NO example queries: the teacher stays zero-shot. v1 kept in intent_descriptions_v1.json; label records carry the version.
activate_my_card: how to activate a newly received card
age_limit: minimum age to open an account or get a card, accounts for children
apple_pay_or_google_pay: topping up or paying with Apple Pay / Google Pay, including when it does not work
atm_support: which ATMs accept the card, ATM availability and support
automatic_top_up: setting up or changing automatic / recurring top-ups
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer into the account has not arrived, balance not updated
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: a cheque or cash deposit has not shown in the balance yet
beneficiary_not_allowed: a transfer to a beneficiary is not possible / not allowed, cannot transfer funds to someone
cancel_transfer: cancel or correct a transfer / transaction made by mistake or sent to the wrong account
card_about_to_expire: card expiring soon: what to do, new card cost and process
card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, merchants or places that take it
card_arrival: when will the ordered card arrive, card has not come yet
card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery time estimate
card_linking: adding or re-adding a card (e.g. one that was found again) to the app
card_not_working: the card does not work anymore or was declined and the customer does not know why (general)
card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was charged for a card payment
card_payment_not_recognised: one or more card payments in the statement the customer did not make
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: a card payment abroad used a wrong or unexpected exchange rate
card_swallowed: the ATM kept / swallowed the card
cash_withdrawal_charge: a fee was charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: an ATM cash withdrawal on the statement the customer did not make
change_pin: how to change the card PIN
compromised_card: suspected fraud: charges the customer did not make, someone may be using the card or account
contactless_not_working: contactless / tap payments specifically do not work
country_support: which countries the service or card is available in
declined_card_payment: a specific card payment was declined at a shop, why
declined_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal was declined / refused
declined_transfer: a transfer was declined or rejected, how to make it go through
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit or recurring payment in the statement the customer does not recognise
disposable_card_limits: limits on disposable virtual cards, how many can be created
edit_personal_details: changing name, address, phone or other personal details
exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used, current rate questions
exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies inside the app
extra_charge_on_statement: an unexplained fee or extra charge on the statement
failed_transfer: a transfer keeps failing, the receiving bank does not accept it
fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies are supported to hold or exchange
get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable single-use virtual card
get_physical_card: where to find the PIN of a new physical card, whether the PIN is sent separately
getting_spare_card: getting a second or additional card on the same account
getting_virtual_card: how to get a virtual card
lost_or_stolen_card: card lost, stolen or cannot be found
lost_or_stolen_phone: phone with the app was lost or stolen
order_physical_card: how to order or receive a physical card, where it can be delivered
passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode / password, cannot log in
pending_card_payment: a card payment is still pending
pending_cash_withdrawal: an ATM withdrawal shows as pending or has not appeared in the account
pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts, how to unblock
receiving_money: receiving salary or payments into the account, choosing the currency for incoming money
Refund_not_showing_up: a refund that was promised has not appeared in the account
request_refund: cancel a purchase or get a refund for something bought
reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reverted / reversed and the customer asks why
supported_cards_and_currencies: which card types (e.g. American Express) and currencies can be used to add funds
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fees or deductions when adding money by bank transfer (SEPA / SWIFT), 'is there a top-up fee'
top_up_by_card_charge: fees when topping up with a debit / credit card, including international cards
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or a cheque
top_up_failed: a top-up failed / was not successful
top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted or cancelled without the customer doing so
topping_up_by_card: topping up the account with the customer's own card: how to, or a card top-up that did not show up
transaction_charged_twice: a transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge
transfer_fee_charged: an unexpected fee on a transfer the customer sent out
transfer_into_account: how to add money to this account by bank transfer from another bank
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer was sent but the recipient has not received it
transfer_timing: how long incoming transfers take, when the money can be used
unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification is failing or cannot be completed
verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, the verification process
verify_source_of_funds: being asked to verify the source of funds
verify_top_up: how to verify or confirm a top-up, or why a top-up needs verification
virtual_card_not_working: a virtual card specifically does not work
visa_or_mastercard: which card network is offered, asking for a Visa or a Mastercard
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: the ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: an ATM withdrawal abroad used a wrong exchange rate
